correctness.rationale: TARGET claims fixed squarefree-N spectral/weight subconvexity with delta=1/51. DRAFT is a transfer sketch, not a rigorous proof: AFE/delta/GL3-Voronoi cited as black boxes while the entire ramified increment (level-N GL2 Voronoi with (q,N)>1, scaled q', dual-length M0*N^{O(1)}, ramified Kloosterman Weil bound, Bessel stationary-phase uniformity, Cauchy/Poisson lattice counts, Atkin-Lehner phase, newform mean-square normalization) is asserted as T-independent N^{O(1)} without estimates. verify_exponent.py checks only fraction arithmetic (3/2, 41/51, 151/102) and dummy N-invariance, not analysis. Essential inferences, boundary conditions and conductor-exponent uniformity are unverified; proof vs arithmetic audit not distinguished.

originality.rationale: Nearest prior Kumar JEMS 2023 proves only N=1 spectral bound; hybrid papers vary both levels in relative ranges and do not imply fixed-N spectral saving. The flagged Munshi Adv.Math.2026 candidate was re-fetched (scope_fulltext FAILED, no OA/arXiv copy, Elsevier/els-cdn/ScienceDirect blocked) and its publisher-indexed scope states the opposite varying direction (fixed GL2 f, varying GL3 level q^2 / twist M,t aspects), disjoint from fixed-pi-SL3Z varying-f-spectral claim. No prior source states or implies fixed squarefree-N delta=1/51 in GL2 spectral/weight aspect.

value.rationale: If rigorously proved, recovering the full-level exponent delta=1/51 at fixed squarefree level for both Maass spectral and holomorphic weight aspects with N absorbed in constant would be an independently retrievable benchmark extension of a recognized GL(3)xGL(2) subconvexity program, motivated before computation, not mechanically implied by N=1, and potentially needed for congruence-subgroup applications. It is not a textbook restatement, arbitrary slice, or tiny unmotivated gain; narrow exact-exponent headline can have record value without a new general theorem.
